name: Image
description: Display an image fetched from a URL, fitted to the widget
config_help:
Shows a PNG or JPEG image, fitted to the widget.

**Server-side sizing:** put `{{width}}` and `{{height}}` in the URL and they're replaced with the widget's pixel size before fetching — e.g. `?w={{width}}&h={{height}}`. Cooperative servers return a right-sized image; otherwise the device downscales it.

url.name: Image URL
url.description: URL of a PNG or JPEG image to display

refresh_seconds.name: Refresh interval (seconds)
refresh_seconds.description: How often to re-fetch the image

sizing.name: Sizing
sizing.description: Fit the whole image (letterboxed), or fill the widget and crop the overflow
